notes.en: Adds editor groups with tabs and split views, tree multi-selection and bulk actions, and rooted EditorConfig indentation settings.
notes.zh-CN: 新增带标签页与分屏视图的编辑器组、文件树多选与批量操作，以及受工作区根目录限制的 EditorConfig 缩进设置。

notes.en: Adds buffer Find and Replace, matching-bracket navigation, and offline word completion from open buffers; improves rendering and graphics across split groups.
notes.zh-CN: 新增缓冲区查找与替换、匹配括号跳转以及基于已打开缓冲区的离线单词补全，并改进分屏组中的渲染与图像显示。

notes.en: Standalone terminal editor built from one pinned zai-editor source revision.
notes.zh-CN: 基于单一固定 zai-editor 源码版本构建的独立终端编辑器。

notes.en: Linux, macOS and Windows builds for x64 and arm64, each bundling LICENSE and the third-party licence notices under licenses/.
notes.zh-CN: 提供 Linux、macOS 与 Windows 的 x64 与 arm64 构建，每个包都附带 LICENSE 以及 licenses/ 下的第三方许可声明。

notes.en: Release assets are published publicly while the application source stays private. Every package is unsigned; check its SHA-256 value after downloading.
notes.zh-CN: 应用源码保持私有，仅公开发布构建产物。所有包均未签名，下载后请校验 SHA-256。

installNotes.en: Extract the archive and put `zai-editor` on your PATH. The build is unsigned; verify the SHA-256 value before running it.
installNotes.zh-CN: 解压后将 `zai-editor` 加入 PATH。该构建未签名，请先校验 SHA-256。
